The continuous no-reload trajectory reaches the highest observed natural far-transfer point without setting landing_state=0xFF. It later stalls at approximately (4246,690) with the animation pointer cleared; no upper-platform landing or scene transition occurs.

conclusions: The v4 recording is a clean canonical replay rather than a new exploratory state history: every compared v3 state field matches across all power-on frames.

The far rope, horizontal line, lower handhold, guard, and upper actor band are all real runtime objects in the same scene; the missing progression is an interaction or spring condition, not a missing scene-state write.
The controlled SCENE_STATE=0x08 fixture remains separate. No natural experiment in this campaign writes the scene exit predicate or reaches the required Y<470 corridor.
